title: Making Complex B2B Workflows Clear, Consistent and Implementable
subtitle: Data-intensive enterprise UX, configuration-heavy tools and AI-assisted delivery

cv.label: Download CV (PDF)
cv.note: Tailored for the Senior Product Designer role

bio.short: I turn complex, configuration-heavy workflows into clear product systems that people can use with confidence. At Datameer, I designed data-intensive analytics for regulated banks and insurers. Ninox and ChurchDesk add no-code configuration, reusable operational workflows and AI-generated output that stays editable. Today I use Claude-directed prototypes and production-connected design infrastructure to shorten the path from evidence to implementation.
bio.long:
At Datameer, I designed query builders, big-data pivot tables, aggregated JSON views, filter logic and uncertainty states. The enterprise analytics platform was used by regulated banks and insurers. I established research in a restricted customer environment and defined design-system component behavior and implementation specifications with Product, UI and Engineering.

At Ninox, I owned the design system for a no-code platform where customers configure their own records, relations, permissions and workflows. I later designed prompt-to-database onboarding in which generated schemas appear in the real editor beside chat and remain directly editable. At ChurchDesk, I reframed a multi-party funeral-booking brief as a reusable capability inside the calendar and form builder. Coordination fell by an estimated 70%, and booking acceptance reached 90%.

Today at Bibel TV, I work hands-on across research, product direction, interaction design and implementation review. I prototype against production APIs with AI coding agents. I also built a token system whose Git repository, CI pipeline and served API keep Android, web and Figma on one source. The EMIL throughline is practical: learn the specialist workflow and make its rules and states legible. Give users and engineers one coherent system to rely on.

context.company: EMIL Group builds SaaS products for the insurance industry and is hiring for complex, configuration-heavy and data-intensive workflows.
context.role: A hands-on senior product-design role spanning continuous validation, information architecture, high-fidelity interaction design, design-system stewardship, AI-assisted prototyping and precise engineering specifications.
context.emphasis: Lead with Datameer's regulated insurer context and data-intensive interfaces, then show Ninox's configurable product system, ChurchDesk's reusable workflow capability and current Claude-assisted implementation practice.
